_doc: D-Noir blood (lane noir): blood is THE colour of this direction. Units: px at 32 px/m world scale (1 m = 32 px), ticks at 60 Hz. spurt = the droplets thrown along the hit direction; each droplet that lands leaves a splat decal. pool = a slow-spreading pool under a kill. Decals persist and fade over fade_ticks after fade_after_ticks. Colours are the protected red the look_noir pass keeps (r high, g/r under 0.14). Splats are teardrops along the drop's travel with satellite drops ahead (blood_marks.gd); a pool is a wobbly wet edge run out along the hit (pool.run) with a bright red meniscus rim around the dark body and a white sheen arc.
